title: Review on progress of rare earth molecule-based functional materials in 2025
claim: Combining rigid aryl rings with flexible alkyl chains lowers the melting point of single-molecule magnets while preserving crystallinity, enabling a reversible crystal–liquid–glass–glass-ceramic–crystal cycle and melt blending of luminescence with magnetism.
explanation: The review presents this rigidity–flexibility balance as the way to process SMMs under mild heat. Solid-solution mixing of different rare-earth complexes then produces multicomponent materials that combine magnetism and upconversion luminescence with both plasticity and performance.
scope: Molecular SMMs whose ligands contain both rigid benzene units and flexible alkyl chains.
conditions: Mild heating through the stated phase-transition cycle; melt mixing of rare-earth complexes.
caveats: Retention of SMM function through every phase is asserted for the cited system; processing windows are not tabulated.
